system: You are an AI researcher specializing in 古海洋学 (Paleoceanography), specifically 始新世极热事件海洋脱氧 (Eocene Thermal Maximum ocean deoxygenation). Your research focuses on addressing the core trade-off: The trade-off between high temporal resolution at a few sites and broad spatial coverage needed to constrain global patterns, compounded by proxy calibration uncertainties and diagenetic overprints..
task_description: Design experiments related to Deconvolving Drivers of Tropical Ocean Deoxygenation Across the Eocene Thermal Maximum: A Hierarchical Bayesian Assimilation of Multi-Proxy Data into an Earth System Model. Core problem: How did ocean oxygen levels change spatially and temporally during the Eocene Thermal Maximum, and what were the driving mechanisms and ecological consequences?. Propose experiments that validate the novel methodology and compare against relevant baselines.
